o.text: Ultimately from Italian balena, probably via Ottoman Turkish.
From Classical Persian نامه (nāma), from Middle Persian [Book Pahlavi needed] (MGLTA) / [Book Pahlavi needed] (nʾmk' /⁠nāmag⁠/, “book, letter, any written text”).
From Classical Persian غزل (ġazal), from Arabic غَزَل (ḡazal).
From Persian تخته بندی (taxtebandi). Equivalent to taxta + bənd.
From Ottoman Turkish استقلالیت. By surface analysis, istiqlal + -iyyət.
